speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I understand you've been feeling very tired, have had some fevers, and are experiencing severe leg pain and bruising. Can you tell me how old you are and if you have noticed any swelling or lumps in your abdomen or neck?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any swollen lymph nodes in your neck, armpits, or groin, or does your abdomen feel enlarged or tender? I would also like to see if you have any pale spots on your skin or if your gums bleed easily.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

text: RESULTS: Complete_Blood_Count: Hemoglobin 10.1 g/dL, Leukocyte Count 63,000/mm3 (elevated), Platelet Count 27,000/mm3 (decreased). Coagulation_Panel: NORMAL READINGS. Peripheral_Smear: NORMAL READINGS.

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood tests show high white blood cells, low platelets, and anemia. Do you have any swollen lymph nodes or an enlarged abdomen?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Unremarkable past medical history. Social history: Attends preschool. Lives with parents and one younger sibling.

text: Do you have any swollen lymph nodes in your neck, armpits, or groin, or does your abdomen feel enlarged or tender? I would also like to see if you have any pale spots on your skin or if your gums bleed easily.

speaker: Patient
text: Positive for fever, bruising, and bone pain. Denies cough, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, or urinary symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the severe bone pain and blood counts, I suspect leukemia, but I need to rule out other causes. Do you have any swollen lymph nodes or an enlarged liver or spleen on exam? REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Aspiration

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: General_Examination: Cervical and axillary lymphadenopathy detected. Abdominal_Examination: Liver palpable 3 cm below the right costal margin, Spleen palpable 2 cm below the left costal margin. Bone_Marrow_Aspirate: Predominantly immature cells that are positive for CD10, CD19, and TdT.

speaker: Doctor
text: The bone marrow results showing CD10, CD19, and TdT positivity confirm Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL)
